description: Deliver one epic slice as one jj change: questions, plan, plan review, implementation, report, approval. Start it with .agents/skills/plan-reviewable-epics/scripts/start-slice.sh <slice-bead> <ID> <epic-folder>.

epic.description: Epic folder under docs/epics, such as mac-shell.

steps.title: {{slice}}: ask the open questions
steps.description: Claim the slice bead. Start the jj change with `jj new` and `jj describe -m "{{slice}}: <outcome>"`. Read the slice bead, docs/epics/{{epic}}/epic.html and the code it touches. Ask every open question in one Inbox thread named "{{slice}}", as :::question blocks with a recommendation. If there are no open questions, say so in the plan and close this step.

steps.title: {{slice}}: write and send the plan
steps.description: Write docs/epics/{{epic}}/tasks/{{slice}}.md with the write-slice-plan skill. Record the answers as decisions in it. Set the slice bead's spec-id to that path. Send the plan in the "{{slice}}" thread as an attachment.

steps.title: {{slice}}: implement
steps.description: Waits for the human gate: close it when the user accepts the plan ("Looks good", "LGTM" or all recommendations chosen). Then implement the plan in the slice's jj change: Rust, FFI, Swift and their tests. Run the checks the plan names: cargo test, cargo clippy, mac-test, ios-test, snapshots.

steps.title: {{slice}}: report
steps.description: Count Rust files: jj diff -r @ --name-only 'glob:**/*.rs'. Zero: send a short report in the "{{slice}}" thread. Some: send the demo as an Inbox message first (screenshots in the body and in attachments), then a guided review of the Rust side (use-plannotator-inbox skill). Discuss review findings in the Inbox before changing code.

steps.title: {{slice}}: close the slice
steps.description: Waits for the human gate: close it when the user approves the slice. Then resolve the "{{slice}}" Inbox thread and close the slice bead. Start the next slice only when the user asks.
